prompt: Our DevOps team wants to extend our AI coding assistants with automated deployment pipeline capabilities. The project lives in /workspace. We need you to find the best available deployment automation skill package from the public community registry, install it to the correct target agents for this project (check the project configuration files — we've already set this up), and save a summary of what you found and installed to a file called install_report.json in the workspace root. Make sure the installation is non-interactive and uses the community registry explicitly.
